note: Flux-integrated differential cross sections for the MINERvA antineutrino CC single-pion-minus-production channel ν̄μ + CH → μ+ + π- + (nucleon(s)), i.e. ν̄μ-CC(π-) production, in the NuMI low-energy antineutrino beam (1.5≤Eν≤10 GeV, θμ≤25°). Six kinematic distributions: muon momentum pμ, muon angle θμ, pion kinetic energy Tπ, pion angle θπ, ν̄μ energy σ(Eν) (bin-integrated, not divided by ΔEν), and Q². Detector: MINERvA fine-grained scintillator tracker + MINOS muon spectrometer. Target: per nucleon (isoscalar-corrected CH target; explicitly labeled "per nucleon" on all plot y-axes and table captions).
